headline: Low pairwise risk overall: no shared channels or writes, but B can ingest audio files while A is a docs-only list with no runtime surface.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: A is a docs-only awesome-list with no I/O surfaces or runtime behavior, while B only processes audio files and has no clipboard, stdin/stdout, MCP, or filesystem write path. No shared communication channel is documented, so an injection pathway is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF A gains a runtime output channel that B parses as instructions, reassess injection risk.
IF B is connected to a shared clipboard or message queue, the pathway changes.
mitigations: Keep the pair disconnected from shared clipboard or message queues.
Document that B treats any external text as untrusted input.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if A ever becomes executable.

B_data_leakage.rationale: A touches no data classes and has no network egress; B touches audio/speech but also has no network egress and no filesystem read/write. The only plausible leakage path would require an unusual shared workspace or manual transfer not shown in either profile, so blast radius appears small.
conditions: IF a shared workspace is introduced, leakage risk increases.
IF either agent is later granted network egress, reassess for exfiltration.
mitigations: Avoid placing sensitive audio in any shared folder.
Keep both agents local-only with no network egress.
Verify that no external sync service watches the workspace.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: A has no write or execution surface, and B explicitly cannot write the filesystem, modify git state, spawn subprocesses, or use MCP. With no overlapping mutable resource access, there is no capability conflict pathway in the documented pair.
conditions: IF A becomes runnable with write access, conflict analysis must be redone.
IF B is granted filesystem or git writes, overlapping-mutation risk appears.
mitigations: Do not attach either agent to a shared mutable repo.
Review permissions before any deployment change.

D_cascading_error.rationale: B can consume audio files, but A does not produce operational outputs or facts for B to act on; it is a static repository listing. That makes a cascading-error chain unlikely, and B has no downstream action authority in the profile.
conditions: IF A is replaced by an executable agent whose outputs feed B, reassess.
IF B is wired to automate actions from transcripts, the blast radius increases.
mitigations: Treat any text derived from A as informational only.
Require human review before any downstream action.
Keep B disconnected from automation hooks.
requires-engineering: add verification gates for any future agent-to-agent pipeline.

E_compliance.rationale: No sensitive data residency or retention mismatch is documented: A touches no data classes, and B only lists audio/speech without any stated regulated-data handling, certifications, or retention policy. With no compliance-specific data flow shown, a breach pathway is not established.
conditions: IF regulated audio such as PHI or EU PII is introduced, compliance review is required.
IF either agent gains documented retention or residency constraints, reassess.
mitigations: Do not route regulated audio through the pair without review.
requires-engineering: add residency and retention controls if regulated data is expected.
